title: Shell-company determination (v0.2)
description: One deterministic Stage 00B-S determination of dei:EntityShellCompany for one carrier row (ADR-094). Exactly one fact is set: shell_company. The four other Stage 00B flags are neither read, set nor inferred, and the five-flag issuer_filters contract is untouched. true is a deterministic hard exclusion carrying dated evidence; false means the firm is retained and asserts nothing about software, product or general eligibility; unknown is retained. Boolean evaluation is a transform-application contract: decoded content is evaluated under its declared transform, because the transform alone does not decide a ballot-box outcome. Byte ranges are half-open [fact_byte_start, fact_byte_end) and fact_element_sha256 covers exactly raw[start:end], the complete raw ix:nonNumeric element, unnormalized. Missing, malformed, unsupported, conflicting, unassignable or multiple assignable facts yield unknown, and agreeing duplicates are never collapsed. Version 0.2.0 successor: ixt:booleantrue and ixt:fixed-true are resolved on the authority of the XBRL Transformation Registry 4 (Transformation Registry 4, namespace http://www.xbrl.org/inlineXBRL/transformation/2020-02-12, elements booleantrue and fixed-true), which fixes their output independently of rendered content. The 0.1.0 schema is retained unchanged and remains the only validator for artefacts written under that contract; this file never validates a 0.1.0 record, and 0.1.0 never validates a 0.2.0 one.
